title: Uncoupled Dirac-Yang-Mills Pairs on Closed Riemannian Spin Manifolds
summary: We study the Dirac-Yang-Mills equations on closed spin manifolds with a focus on uncoupled solutions, i.e. solutions for which the connection form satisfies the Yang-Mills equation. Such solutions require the Dirac current, a quadratic form on the spinor bundle, to vanish. We study the condition that this current vanishes on all harmonic spinors using perturbation theory and obtain a classification of the connection forms for which this holds, which we show contains an open and dense subset of connections.
